tasks.title: The Economic Rise of Medieval Florence
paras: In the Central Middle Ages, starting around 1000 A.D., a number of northern Italian cities, including Venice and Genoa, rode a wave of economic and population growth that saw them become among the most prosperous and powerful cities in Europe. Florence, though a late starter because of its isolation from the sea and the trade opportunities it offered, caught up with and overtook its rivals by engaging in manufacture and commerce, as well as trade. How did it manage to climb to its powerful position by the end of the Middle Ages (ca.1400 A.D.)?

All the cities of Europe were becoming manufacturing centers, but Florence did it better than most. The industry was textiles, or cloth production. During most of the Middle Ages, textile production tasks such as spinning, weaving, and dyeing were carried out in small workshops that combined together in a complex collective organization. Master craftsmen controlled the manufacturing, while the buying and selling was carried on by merchants. This medieval system was transformed in two ways, and Florence took the decisive lead in both. Firstly, the master craftsmen and merchants were replaced by a new breed of entrepreneurs who controlled both the trading and manufacture of textiles. From the thirteenth century Florentine merchant entrepreneurs set up offices in cities all over Europe from Edinburgh to Constantinople—the archive of the Datini family shows letters from customers and suppliers from 200 different European towns—while they also bought up workshops in Florence and employed managers to run them.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the passage?

options.A: To compare the economic growth of Venice and Genoa with that of Florence
options.B: To explain how Florence rose to economic power in the Central Middle Ages
options.C: To describe the transformation of textile production in medieval Europe
options.D: To analyze the role of the Datini family in expanding European trade

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 答案分析：文本结构与核心问题： 首段提出核心疑问："How did [Florence] manage to climb to its powerful position by the end of the Middle Ages?"（佛罗伦萨如何在中世纪末期崛起为强国？）。 后续段落围绕这一问题展开，聚焦佛罗伦萨的经济策略（如纺织业创新、企业家模式）。 选项分析： A 错误：威尼斯和热那亚仅为背景对比（"late starter"），非全文比较对象。 B 正确：全文围绕佛罗伦萨的崛起路径展开，从“起步晚”到“通过制造业与商业超越对手”，最终解释其成功原因（企业家整合生产与贸易）。 C 片面：纺织业转型是佛罗伦萨崛起的具体手段，而非主旨；且范围限定为“欧洲”，但文本核心是“佛罗伦萨”。 D 细节：Datini家族是举例论证（"archive shows letters..."），用于支撑“跨国商业网络”的论点，非主旨。 关键逻辑链： 问题引入（佛罗伦萨如何崛起）→ 对比背景（欧洲城市制造业趋势）→ 核心创新（企业家整合生产与贸易）→ 案例佐证（Datini家族的跨国布局）。 结论：文本主旨是解释佛罗伦萨在中世纪中期的经济崛起方式，对应选项B。

questions.stem: The word “rivals” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题。 正确答案分析：rival意思为”竞争对手”，competitor的意思为”竞争者”，答案选择B项。 选项分析： critic的意思为”评论家”，neighbor的意思为”邻居”，superior的意思为”上级，上司”。

questions.stem: What can be inferred from paragraph 1 about Venice and Genoa during the Central Middle Ages?

options.A: They were more involved in commerce than they were in manufacturing.
options.B: They were dependent upon trade with Florence.
options.C: They benefited from being close to ocean trade routes.
options.D: They had strong economic ties to other European cities.

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题。 正确答案分析：根据Venice and Genoa定位到第一句，提到这两个城市在经济和人口增长的浪潮中，成为欧洲最繁荣、最强大的城市之一。但和选项均无关系。接下来提到佛罗伦萨因为远离大海以及由海洋提供的贸易机会，所以起步较晚。由此可以反推出Venice and Genoa离海洋较劲并受益于海洋贸易机会。故答案选择C项。

questions.stem: According to paragraph 2, all of the following are true of the textile industry during most of the Middle Ages EXCEPT:

options.A: Textiles were produced in small workshops.
options.B: Textile trading and manufacturing were separately controlled.
options.C: Textile products were transported to markets by master craftsmen.
options.D: Some textile workshops were joined in collective organizations.

questions.analysis: 题型：否定事实信息题。 原文定位：根据题干the textile industry during most of the Middle Ages定位到During most of the Middle Ages, textile production tasks such as spinning, weaving, and dyeing were carried out in small workshops that combined together in a complex collective organization，可以和A项和D项对应。接着Master craftsmen controlled the manufacturing, while the buying and selling was carried on by merchants和B项对应，所以答案选C。

questions.stem: Which of the sentences below best expresses the essential information in the highlighted sentence in the passage? Incorrect choices change the meaning in important ways or leave out essential information.

options.A: The archive of the Datini family reveals the duties of Florentine merchant entrepreneurs, which included establishing and managing workshops.
options.B: During the thirteenth century, merchant entrepreneurs traveled throughout Europe, setting up and managing workshops in cities as far apart as Edinburgh and Constantinople.
options.C: Powerful merchant entrepreneurs such as the Datini family communicated with customers all over Europe who wanted to buy and manage workshops in Florence.
options.D: Thirteenth-century merchant entrepreneurs in Florence established offices throughout Europe in addition to purchasing workshops in Florence and hiring manage to operate them.

questions.analysis: 题型：句子简化题。 句子的主要信息为From the thirteenth century Florentine merchant entrepreneurs set up offices in cities all over Europe…while they also bought up workshops in Florence and employed managers to run them, 佛罗伦萨的商人企业家在欧洲各地的城市设立了办事处……同时，他们还在佛罗伦萨买下了车间，并聘请了经理来经营。A项Datini家族的档案揭示了佛罗伦萨商人企业家的职责,和主要信息不符。B项商人企业家在欧洲各地旅行，建立和管理车间，和主要信息矛盾。C项Datini家族等强大的商业企业家与欧洲各地希望在佛罗伦萨购买和管理车间的客户进行了沟通，也和主要信息不符。D项13世纪佛罗伦萨的商人企业家在整个欧洲建立了办事处，此外还在佛罗伦萨购买车间并聘请经理来运营车间，和主要信息一致，答案选择D项
